title: Discover an amazing app designed to help you stay on top of your game with effortless reminders, eff
body:
The application has highly beneficial features designed to enhance productivity and organisation. Among its many tools are comprehensive habit trackers that allow users to monitor their daily routines and progress over time. The app also includes robust to-do lists that help users prioritise tasks efficiently and customizable reminders that can be categorised for better organisation.

In addition, an intuitive countdown feature enables users to track the days remaining until a specific event or to keep a record of how many days have passed since a notable date, which can be particularly useful for project deadlines or personal milestones. Furthermore, the app incorporates an Eisenhower Matrix, a strategic tool that helps users distinguish between urgent and essential tasks, facilitating more effective decision-making and time management.

title: App is fine, but support is slow and often dismissive or not helpful
body:
I’ve used TickTick for years, and was fairly happy with it overall, and have been a paid user for years, but I’m moving away from it for two main reasons: Generally unimpressive support, and an instance of data loss that they seem disinterested in helping with.

My advice to those thinking of using TickTick is: The app is generally good, but support and the only available support mechanism is slow and painful. If you ever need to use it you will not likely come away happy.

I’ve used the support for the app a number of times over several years, mostly for suggestions/questions, and have never been impressed with it. The support mechanism seems to be limited to a chat style system within the app itself and, in my experience, you can go days (sometimes even weeks/months) before you get a response. How is something supposed to be resolved in a timely fashion if the chat turnaround is measured in days rather than hours or minutes?

With regards to my data loss situation, I had a list with 5-6 sections and more than 80 items arranged across them. One day I opened the list to find that suddenly all items had somehow been moved into a single section. I’m now 15 days into trying to get this resolved and the (minimal) replies I’ve had from the company have largely ignored my questions or requests for information, and the one fix they did (maybe, I’m not sure what they actually did, because no details) didn’t fix anything, as far as I can tell. They said to contact them if that didn’t fix things, so I did, immediately, and it’s now been 5 days and I haven’t heard a thing. Not from the chat system, and not from their twitter account, which is either unobservant (they’ve replied to me in the past), or just ignoring me.
